description: An error of the grammar inside an attachment ends the stage's emission: the stage keeps its verdict and has no output (engine §11).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item $w:word | $w:word $a:ii %emits $w ($a)
%rule word W
%rule ii $x:marker $y:marker %emits $x, $y
%rule marker :- $.verbatim-text | I
```
